info.title: FeedHorizon API
info.description:
Schedule and publish social media posts across platforms, manage profiles, accounts, webhooks and API keys.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer fh_…`. Every response carries `x-request-id`.

Rate limits per API key and minute, by plan: free 60, paid 600. `GET /me` shows the limit of your key.

tags.name: Me
tags.description: Who is calling: organization, plan, rate limit and the permissions of the key. A good first call for SDKs and agents.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Create, schedule, publish and track posts. A post has one target per social account.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Images, videos and PDFs for posts: import from a URL or upload directly, then use the id in mediaIds.

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Brands or clients inside your organization. Accounts and posts belong to a profile.

tags.name: Queue
tags.description: Weekly posting times per profile. Posts created with addToQueue take the next free slot.

tags.name: Platforms
tags.description: What each platform accepts: text length, media types and counts, and whether publishing is available yet.

tags.name: Platform invites
tags.description: Links your clients open to connect their own social accounts.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Signed HTTP callbacks for post and account events.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: Keys for this API. Managing them needs a key with access to all profiles.

tags.name: Webhook events
tags.description: What FeedHorizon sends to your webhook URL for each event. Subscribe with POST /webhooks.

get.description:
Newest first. With `from` or `to` the list becomes a calendar range: posts whose publish time (published, else scheduled) falls in [from, to), oldest first. Pages by cursor: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null.

Requires `posts:read`.

post.description:
Creates a draft, a scheduled post, a queued post or publishes right away, depending on which timing field you send. Use `targets` to give single accounts their own text. The post is checked against every platform first; all problems come back at once in `error.details` (try `POST /posts/validate` for a dry run). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

Requires `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first response instead of running again.

content.description: Post text. Each account can get its own text through targets
examples: Five-minute tomato soup, our quickest weeknight dinner.

platforms.description: Publish to every active account of these platforms in the profile

items.description: Platform id. Publishing works on tiktok, instagram, linkedin, twitter, bluesky, pinterest today; the others are planned

accountIds.description: Or name the accounts explicitly (wins over platforms)

targets.description: The accounts to publish to, each with optional own text. Wins over platforms and accountIds

mediaIds.description: Files from POST /media, in display order

scheduledFor.description: Schedule for this time. Leave out all three timing fields for a draft

addToQueue.description: Take the profile's next free queue slot

timezone.description: Time zone shown with the post. Defaults to the profile's

post.description:
Two ways to add a file, then pass its `id` in `mediaIds` when creating or updating a post.

- **Import from a URL**: send `url` (public https, up to 100 MB). FeedHorizon downloads it and answers when it is stored. Easiest for agents and scripts.
- **Upload**: send `filename`, `mimeType` and `sizeBytes` (up to 5 GB). The answer carries `upload.url`; `PUT` the raw bytes there with the same `Content-Type` within two hours. No API key is needed for that request.

Supported types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/webm, application/pdf. Which platform takes which type is listed under `GET /platforms`.

Requires `posts:write`.
